The sophisticated ambiance, paired with a romantic moonlit setting, set the stage for a perfect culinary experience. The meticulously crafted dishes, handpicked fresh ingredients, and delightful desserts showcased the harmonious blend of Asian and European delights. The unintrusive service and attention to detail made it a memorable dining experience, making this restaurant a hidden gem in Hanoi.
